note: Cards that send a reader to one of the other HoopsMatic games with a SPECIFIC challenge rather than a link to a homepage. Hand-written: there is no builder, so adding a game is adding an entry here. Every url must also be registered in data/links.json or tools/test_links.mjs fails - that registry is what notices when one of these dies.
how_to_add: Copy an entry, give it a new id, and write a hook that states the actual challenge. 'Open the Career Map' is a link; 'Trace a career across every team he played for' is a card. The hook is the whole point of doing this rather than putting a nav bar in the feed.
only_three_games_so_far: 73-9 Daily, the original 73-9 game and the Career Map are the ones whose live URLs were confirmed. GOAT Machine, Beat LeBron, Rumor Daily, Garbage Time and the Ball Race are not in here because a card pointing at a URL that 404s is worse than no card. Add them with their real addresses.

payload.hook: Ten players, one from each of today's ten teams, $150M to spend. Build the squad that beats the 73-9 Warriors.
payload.note: Everyone gets the same ten teams. Three attempts, then it locks until 9am ET.

payload.hook: There is exactly one best squad on today's board. Most people find three or four of its ten players.
payload.note: Solve it and you go on the streak board.

payload.hook: Spin five players out of NBA history, fit them under the cap, and see what your team does across 82 games against the 2015-16 Warriors.
One player, every club he ever signed for, in order. Name him before the trail runs out.
payload.note: Survival: three wrong answers and it is over.

payload.hook: 5,100 players and every team, club and country they ever played for, on one map.
payload.note: Well-travelled careers, reunions, All-Stars who finished abroad.

payload.hook: Which NBA players came through the clubs in your country?
payload.note: Every team page lists who passed through, era-accurate names included.
